advice: Abstain. The supplied panel helper reads its A operand directly and performs its own packing. A separate FP32 ZA transpose tile cannot feed that helper through the fixed ABI, so adding one would be unused work. A useful fused experiment would require a verified consumer that accepts the transposed panel; none is supplied.
risks: The sixteen-call panel path was already measured and did not show a repeatable gain. Do not infer a benefit from smaller scratch alone. No new implementation, correctness result, or performance result is established.
